fields.value: The ORIGINAL's T_rest split — the only unmeasured term. It reaches -42.6/frame after the bounce and DECAYS 6x AT CONSTANT SPEED as the car straightens (-34.5 at s_from 190.6 down, -5.5 at 193.5 up) while the port's is -0.43/frame. Fit accum from the per-wheel forces at record wheelbase+0x70..0x78 on the PORT first (friction_diag.log is the known-answer self-check), then apply it to orig_fp2.msd.

fields.label: Instrument lesson
fields.value: A detector validated on ONE side can be swamped on the other, and the swamping is the finding. The 1.02-ratio contact detector passed 23 of 23 on the original and still failed on the port. Validate cross-side detectors on both sides, and look for the contamination-proof statistic instead of discarding the channel.
